description: This Java source file defines the class UsernamePasswordAuthProvider, which is an authentication provider that verifies username/password credentials using Hono's Credentials API. It includes methods for extracting credentials from JSON, validating them asynchronously within Vert.x, and handles dependency injection via constructors.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordAuthProvider
classes.description: An authentication provider that verifies username/password credentials via Hono's Credentials API.
